verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a first-party capability for viewing or managing external issue-tracker tickets inside GitLab, or for opening them from merge requests. The only related items are third-party partner tools: Unito syncs GitLab with Jira and Trello, Relokia migrates data, and Notion pulls GitLab data into Notion. None of these is GitLab's own in-product external tracker view, and the vague monday.com listing describes no such feature.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage tickets from an external issue tracker inside the code host and open them from pull requests
